notes.title: Patch 1.0.0.13 is now available!
notes.content:
Riders, a new update is now available! Please check all the news in the list below:

[list]
[*] Increased top speed for all motorcycles
[*] Time Trial: rewards are now based on completed laps instead of completed valid laps only
[*] Time Trial: the quick leaderboard in pre-race menu now shows the best valid lap for each bike model 
[*] Reduced grip on grass and sand when “Off-Track Help” option is Off
[*] Missing exhaust on Ducati 1098R RM 2008 added 
[*] Headlights issue on Kawasaki ZX-10R 2004 fixed 
[*] Sparks issue on Kawasaki ZX-6R 2019 fixed
[*] Added support for add-ons
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Ultimate 2020 DLC is now available
notes.content:
Hello riders!

As you may know, our post launch support for RIDE 4 is huge! We're adding content each month, both free and premium, aiming to make our beloved game always better.

Today it's time for the Ultimate 2020 DLC, a content pack that you'll love for sure. Please find all the new things in the list below, and remember to keep report to us your feedbacks and opinions.

[list]
[*] 5 exclusive bikes: MV Agusta Superveloce 800 (2019), Triumph Daytona 765 Moto2 (2020), Yamaha YZF-R1M (2020), Ducati V4 S Naked - Racing Modified (2020), Energica Ego (2020)
[*] 10 extra events.
[/list]
